response.rationale: A and B name essentially the same capability: scheduling and managing skating sessions. Both are anchored on the same class, RinkService (node 21c65604dec116b1, domain layer, business component). B is only a little narrower: it says "public" sessions and adds capacity management. A's grouping also includes SessionRepository, the persistence class that stores sessions for RinkService. The groupings differ: A is the community of rink classes (bookings, payments, hire stock), and B is the business component. That difference reflects the clustering method, not a different business function. The capability being described is the same.
